notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.notes:
Thank you very much to everyone who played and left their comments!

After them, I decided to make a few changes:



- On the 5th week, a saw appeared under the bed, so that u wouldn't have to run every time.

- The Bush-Neighbor now works according to unique rules and has its own cutscene, and in general should be activated less often.

- Improved object physics, now knives will get stuck less often

- Tutorial in the utility room is no longer confusing

- Tutorial in the basement is now a little more obvious

- Added the Child Play achievement, it was really asking for it.

- Added 4 new languages.

- Police officers began to see noticeably worse.

- And even more small changes designed to simplify the game...



The following bug fixes were also made:

- You can no longer get out of the basement if you locked yourself in, accept death!

- Fixed the tree that everyone was tripping over

- Weekly achievement, now correctly awarded on the third

- You can now get objects out of the barrel if you dropped them there

- The Morbid Engineering and You're doing it wrong achievements can now be correctly obtained.



P.S. I hope I managed to reduce the difficulty without depriving the game of a challenge. I will wait for your amazing comments ^_^
